basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old music enthusiast from Essex, UK, currently working as a barista. I recently got into electronic music and I'm passionate about learning to compose and perform live music. When I'm not exploring synths, I enjoy spending time with my pet hedgehog, binge-watching documentaries about reptiles, or recovering from my latest skateboarding mishap. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work or during weekends. I'm single and hoping to connect with fellow music lovers and synth enthusiasts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a newcomer to synthesizers, most of my knowledge comes from online tutorials and forums. I have a basic understanding of music theory from high school and have been experimenting with free software to get the hang of electronic music production.
